title: Design System: Used Car Price Predictor

headline.purpose: The one H1 per page and metric-card values; H1 24px below 480px.

lede.purpose: One muted sentence under the H1, max 68ch.

title.purpose: Section and card titles; chart titles state the finding.

label.purpose: Widget labels, metric labels, status pill.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Keyboard focus on buttons and focused fields; dark mode uses rgba(124, 155, 255, 0.32).

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All state transitions (150ms) and the estimate reveal.

motion.name: estimate-reveal
motion.value: 520ms: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(4px) to 0, blur(4px) to 0
motion.purpose: The app's one authored motion, on the estimate figure; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

chartSlots.placeholders: #000001 to #000010, swapped by Streamlit for the active theme's chartCategoricalColors

extensions.outOfSystem: Static matplotlib and SHAP report figures keep the A7 palette (constants at the top of src/carprice/palette.py) by design; they are not part of this GUI system.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action, e.g. Estimate price; full width under the input panel.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--cp-primary, #2F5BEA); background: #2F5BEA; color: #FFFFFF; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2449C9; border-color: #2449C9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47, 91, 234, 0.22); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--cp-border, #E4E4E7); background: var(--cp-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--cp-subtle, #F4F4F5); border-color: var(--cp-border-strong, #D4D4D8); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47, 91, 234, 0.22); }

components.name: Number Field
components.description: Labelled numeric input with tabular figures.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); } .ds-input { font: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--cp-border, #E4E4E7); background: var(--cp-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--cp-border-strong, #D4D4D8); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--cp-primary, #2F5BEA); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47, 91, 234, 0.22); }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: White header with brand mark, wordmark and page tabs; selection in ink, not blue.
components.html: Used Car Price PredictorPrice estimatorMarket explorerModel performance
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--cp-surface, #FFFFFF); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--cp-border, #E4E4E7); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; margin-right: 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--cp-muted, #71717A); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--cp-subtle, #F4F4F5); color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cp-primary, #2F5BEA); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--cp-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--cp-border, #E4E4E7); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; } .ds-metric-label { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--cp-muted, #71717A); } .ds-metric-value { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); } .ds-caption { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--cp-muted, #71717A); }

components.name: Caution Note
components.description: Full border and tint, bold lead phrase; neutral and error variants share the shape.
components.html: Few similar cars. The model has seen fewer than 20 listings like this one, so treat the range with care.
components.css: .ds-note { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); background: var(--cp-subtle, #F4F4F5); border: 1px solid var(--cp-border, #E4E4E7); border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px 16px; } .ds-note strong { font-weight: 600; } .ds-note-caution { background: var(--cp-caution-bg, #FFFBEB); border-color: var(--cp-caution-border, #FDE68A); } .ds-note-caution strong { color: var(--cp-caution-ink, #B45309); }

components.name: Stale Pill
components.description: Flags a result that no longer matches the inputs.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--cp-caution-border, #FDE68A); background: var(--cp-caution-bg, #FFFBEB); color: var(--cp-caution-ink, #B45309); } .ds-pill::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Estimate with Range Bar
components.description: Signature: the estimate in display type over the 80% band with one amber diamond.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-estimate-card { font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--cp-surface, #FFFFFF); border: 1px solid var(--cp-border, #E4E4E7); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; } .ds-est-label { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--cp-muted, #71717A); } .ds-est { margin: 8px 0; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.035em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); animation: ds-reveal 520ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-est-meta { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--cp-muted, #71717A); } .ds-est-meta strong { color: var(--cp-ink, #18181B); font-weight: 500; } .ds-range { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 16px; } @keyframes ds-reveal { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); filter: blur(4px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-est { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The category standard, a clean product dashboard, played straight at the craft level of Linear, the Vercel dashboard and the Stripe dashboard. Zinc neutrals carry almost every pixel; one blue does the acting (buttons, selection, the main chart series) and one amber marks the single thing worth looking at on a view. Hierarchy comes from size, weight and space, not from colour or decoration. The estimate is the largest object on the estimator, and every chart sits in a bordered card with a finding-style title above it and a plain-English takeaway below it.

Density is calm, not sparse: 14px body text, 24px card padding, a 1200px content column, a two-column work area that collapses to one below 960px. Surfaces are flat, separated by 1px hairlines. Light and dark modes are the same system: every token has a dark counterpart and switches with Streamlit's own theme picker without a rerun.

What it refuses: the template look of a default Streamlit app (red accent, sidebar navigation, equal cards everywhere, weak hierarchy) and decorative colour.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc neutral ramp, one blue action colour, one amber highlight per view.
Geist throughout, tabular figures for every number.
Top-tab navigation in a white header; no sidebar.
Every chart framed as title, chart, one-sentence takeaway.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber appears at most once per view, on the data mark that answers the page's question. Pages that only explain (About and data) carry none.

rules.name: The Blue Acts Rule
rules.body: Blue means "this does something or this is the main series". Tabs and nav use ink, not blue, for their selected state.

rules.name: The Slot Rule
rules.body: Plotly figures never take hex values. They draw with placeholder colours #000001 to #000010 that Streamlit swaps for the active theme's ten chart slots: six series (primary, ink, highlight, teal, rose, slate), then muted, border, grid, surface.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every price, metric, slider value and number input uses tabular figures.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400, 500 and 600 only. No bold 700, no light weights.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Cards are separated by a 1px border, never by a drop shadow.

dos: Do take every GUI colour from theme.css tokens in CSS and from chart slot placeholders in Plotly, so both modes switch without a rerun.
Do keep amber to one data mark per view, and none on explanatory pages.
Do give every chart a finding-style title and a takeaway sentence beneath it.
Do show prices with the rupee sign, Indian grouping and a lakh figure, in tabular figures.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 or better on page and cards in both modes, and unselected control outlines at 3:1.
donts: Don't use drop shadows on cards; separate with a 1px hairline.
Don't put a coloured stripe on one side of a note; use a full border and tint.
Don't colour tabs or nav selection blue; ink carries selection there.
Don't add a font weight beyond 400, 500 and 600, or a second display family.

Don't use the A7 report palette (teal #0E7C7B, warm off-white #F7F5F0, DM Serif, Inter) in the GUI. Static matplotlib and SHAP report figures keep it by design (constants at the top of src/carprice/palette.py); they sit outside this system.
